knownAdapterLimitations.forgedSuccessCount: the adapter checks the success count only through P6 consistency. At a 21-entry ledger P6 is NOT_TRIGGERED for any value at or above 50, so a forged value above the floor passes. Landed limitation; the defence is that the count is derived independently here and re-derived at adjudication, never read from an adapter
knownAdapterLimitations.spentStrategyReplay: the adapter would accept a spent strategy replayed against a ledger revision that still matches its own binding. Window 03's strategy binds the nineteen-entry ledger and so cannot bind here; the general defence is procedural

negativeProbes.executedAgainst: the exact committed strategy bytes, mutated one probe at a time, fed to the landed windowSpecFromAcquisitionWindowStrategy against the real 21-entry ledger

probe7IsANEWLYSURFACEDLIMITATION.theRealLimitation: the strategy adapter has NO access to acquisition outcomes. It validates the declared CURRENT_ACQUISITION_FAILURE set and pendingReplacementObligations only for internal consistency against the ledger and the frozen draw - that a served slot has a declared obligation, that its occupant kind matches the ledger, that reserve positions are the planner own, that reasons match the declared obligation, and that primaries are contiguous from the declared nextNeverStartedSelectionIndex. It never asks whether those slots actually failed, because nothing in its inputs records an outcome
probe7IsANEWLYSURFACEDLIMITATION.whatProbe2ActuallyProves: probe 2 was refused because it served slot 45 while the declared obligations still listed only slot 54. The guard it exercises is "a served replacement must carry a DECLARED obligation", NOT "a served replacement must really be failing". Those are different guarantees and only the first exists
probe7IsANEWLYSURFACEDLIMITATION.whyThisIsNotAnOpenDefectInThisWindow: this window served exactly the one slot that the committed Window-03 adjudication recorded as failing, and the strategy derived that set from a 110-slot status map rebuilt from the committed adjudication chain rather than declaring it. The limitation would matter to a strategy whose state section was wrong; it does not make this strategy wrong
probe7IsANEWLYSURFACEDLIMITATION.sameFamilyAs: the forged success count in probe 9. Both are declared-state fields the adapter cross-checks loosely and cannot falsify
probe7IsANEWLYSURFACEDLIMITATION.defence: entirely upstream and downstream of the adapter: the state is derived independently when the strategy is written, and recomputed from scratch at adjudication. No step reads an outcome from the adapter. Closing it inside the adapter would mean giving it a source of adjudicated outcomes, which is a code change and is not authorised under this resumption
